title: eval-harness: add per-prompt CI hook and quality gating thresholds
author: Riley Turner
description: Add a per-prompt CI hook into the eval-harness pipeline and configurable quality gating thresholds. Motivation: a number of recent regressions slipped past per-suite checks because regressions were localized to specific prompt sets. This PR implements a lightweight per-prompt evaluator that runs as a CI hook, emits per-prompt metrics to the metrics backend, and fails the pipeline when prompt-level regressions exceed configured thresholds. The change includes: (1) hook implementation, (2) metrics integration (prometheus/exporter), (3) a new config block for per-prompt thresholds, and (4) unit and integration tests. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and threshold tuning notes. Backwards compatible: defaults keep previous behaviour unless per-prompt configs are added.

release_notes: Added per-prompt CI hook to eval-harness. New configurable per-prompt quality gating thresholds and metrics emissions. Default behaviour unchanged. Useful for catching regressions that affect specific prompt sets.
notes: Rollout plan: enable per-prompt gating in staging for ENG-2317, monitor per-prompt metrics for 2 weeks, then enable in production for high-risk prompt sets. Thresholds tuned by SRE and model owners.
